tiers.everyday: One of the bells of the battleship USS Arizona, sunk at Pearl Harbor, hangs in a tower at the University of Arizona. It came there in 1946.
tiers.student: UA Libraries: the bell was found in June 1944 at the Bremerton salvage yard, arrived on Navy Day, 27 October 1946, and has hung in the Student Union tower since 1951.
